name: NoraeBar
description: NoraeBar is a vibrant karaoke venue known for its private rooms and lively main stage. It offers a fun, welcoming atmosphere with a broad song selection, modern sound systems, and friendly staff. Guests can enjoy a variety of cocktails and mocktails, making it suitable for private parties, birthdays, or casual nights out. The venue emphasizes safety with private rooms and COVID precautions, creating a perfect space for all karaoke lovers to sing their hearts out in Louisville.
